plugins.name: hve-squad-hve-core
plugins.description: microsoft/hve-core pinned to the exact commit validated against hve-squad 0.18.0's apm.yml (Sync and Adapt / cast-delta guard). Install this INSTEAD OF the official hve-core plugin, not alongside it: the distinct name only prevents a name collision at install time, and registering both gives you a second, unpinned copy of every hve-core agent that squad roles can resolve to. Refresh it with uninstall-then-install; plugin update cannot see a new pin because the recorded version comes from upstream hve-core's own plugin.json.
